answer: Each task is instantiated only after a specified future drand quicknet pulse: its threshold-BLS randomness derives the challenge seed, binding prompts, deadlines, and scoring to a value unavailable in advance. A commit-reveal check can bind each response to that seed, so copied walnut, dune, or knoll templates cannot be farmed offline or replayed across identities; Sybil accounts must obtain fresh, timely work for every pulse.
